clue.text: The rest live outside the upper class

indicators.note: the word for living somewhere is wrapped around the letter for the upper class

parts.note: to reside is to live in a place
U is the old label for upper-class usage

explanation.surface: Everyone else lives apart from the toffs.
explanation.definitionFit: A residue is what remains, the remainder left over.

clue.text: Sapper character must do the letter again

parts.note: a sapper is a soldier of the Royal Engineers, abbreviated RE
a type is a printed character or letter

explanation.surface: An army engineer's personality obliges him to write a letter a second time.
explanation.definitionFit: To key or print a document over again is a repeat of its typing.

clue.text: He may occupy floor or. chair

definitions.text: He may occupy floor or. chair

parts.words: He may occupy floor or. chair
parts.note: one who holds the floor in a debate, or the presiding officer in the Commons who sits in the chair

explanation.surface: Someone who might sit on the ground or on a seat.
explanation.definitionFit: Holding the floor means addressing a meeting, and the Commons' chairman bears the same title as anyone talking.

clue.text: Repudiated David, so we broke down

indicators.note: the letters of these words collapse and are put back together in a fresh order

explanation.surface: Someone disowned David, and the group collapsed in tears.
explanation.definitionFit: To repudiate something is to disown or deny it publicly.

clue.text: Considered the. idea and gave a party

explanation.surface: Someone thought it over and then threw a celebration.
explanation.definitionFit: To harbour a thought is to give it house room; to host guests at a party is to receive them.

clue.text: The Gobelin damaged ? How mean !

indicators.note: the tapestry's name is wrecked so its letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A precious French tapestry has been ruined, what a shabby thing to do.
explanation.walkthrough: A Gobelin is a tapestry from the famous Paris works.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignoble describes base, dishonourable, petty conduct.

clue.text: Conditions in one feminine quarter

parts.note: the Roman numeral for one
F is the grammatical abbreviation for feminine
S, south, is one quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: Terms laid down within a women's district.
explanation.definitionFit: Each 'if' introduces a proviso, so the plural noun means stipulations.

clue.text: Specifies means to be altered

indicators.note: the word means has to change its shape, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The method is stated, but must be changed.
explanation.definitionFit: To name something is to identify or specify it exactly.

clue.text: Possible berth to engage for wedding

indicators.note: the letters could possibly form another word, so they are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A potential ship's cabin booked for a marriage voyage.
explanation.definitionFit: To pledge someone in marriage is to promise them to a future spouse.

clue.text: The opposite of a ravenous remark

definitions.text: The opposite of a ravenous remark

parts.words: The opposite of a ravenous remark
parts.note: 'ravenous' is read as belonging to a raven: Poe's raven only ever croaks a word meaning never again, and its opposite means for all time

explanation.surface: Contrary to what a starving person might say.
explanation.definitionFit: Evermore means for all time, always.

clue.text: The right places for Shakespeare's nasty Greek

parts.note: sites are places or locations

explanation.surface: Ideal locations for staging a villain from a Shakespeare play.
explanation.walkthrough: Thersites is the foul-mouthed Greek soldier in Troilus and Cressida.
explanation.definitionFit: The scurrilous railing Greek of Troilus and Cressida bears this name.

clue.text: Joint that's topping for a bishop

explanation.surface: A connection that crowns a churchman.
explanation.definitionFit: A carpenter's angled corner join, and the tall headdress a bishop wears.

clue.text: In Russia, let me add, a KO leads to victory

parts.note: a postscript, PS, is something added to a letter
a knockout in boxing

explanation.surface: A Russian boxer's knockout punch wins the fight, as a postscript notes.
explanation.walkthrough: Pskov is an ancient city in north-west Russia.
explanation.definitionFit: Pskov is a historic city located in the Russian north-west.

clue.text: Bad weather for gunners in attack

parts.note: the Royal Artillery, RA, are the army's gunners
to storm a position is to attack it

explanation.surface: Artillery men caught in an assault during foul conditions.
explanation.definitionFit: A downpour with high winds is foul meteorological conditions.

clue.text: On one point I call it clever beyond question

parts.note: I as the Roman numeral one
N, north, is a point of the compass
to dub is to call or name
able means capable or clever

explanation.surface: On a single issue, someone judges a thing smart past all doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: Indubitable means undoubted, certain.

clue.text: Get five bob with a couple of flukes at this game

parts.note: a crown was an old British coin worth five shillings ('bob')
and means together with
an anchor has two flukes, the barbed arms that dig into the seabed

explanation.surface: A gambler wins five shillings thanks to two lucky breaks at the table.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Flukes' looks like lucky chances; they are the arms of an anchor. Crown and anchor is a dice gambling game.
explanation.definitionFit: This dice game, played with symbols on the faces, is a betting pastime.

clue.text: The fisherman's return

parts.note: 'return' read as profit, and a fisherman's catch comes in his net

explanation.surface: An angler's journey home.
explanation.definitionFit: The earnings left after all costs is what a business really gains.

clue.text: Conceals obsolete remedies

parts.note: obs. is the dictionary abbreviation for obsolete
cures are remedies

explanation.surface: Someone hides outdated treatments.
explanation.definitionFit: To obscure something is to hide it from view.

clue.text: Some loaf, flatter too, for a livelihood

parts.note: a loaf is a quantity of bread
and means as well
to butter up is to flatter

explanation.surface: Laze about and sweet-talk too, just to earn a living.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loaf' looks like a verb, idle; here it is a loaf of bread.
explanation.definitionFit: One's basic source of income is one's staple earnings.

clue.text: Distinguish French maid returning to Latin quarter

indicators.note: the French word for a maid comes back the other way

parts.note: bonne is French for a maidservant
E, east, is a quarter of the compass

explanation.surface: A French servant heads back to the Parisian student district and stands out.
explanation.definitionFit: To ennoble is to dignify or confer distinction on.

clue.text: Abstract or representative miniature

explanation.surface: A summary, or a small-scale typical model.
explanation.definitionFit: A summary of a book, and a perfect typical example in small.

clue.text: Flower that may shoot up

explanation.surface: A bloom that could sprout upward.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden plant of the cabbage family with flowers, and a firework or missile that soars.

clue.text: Agreement at'the Vatican

parts.note: concord means harmony or agreement

explanation.surface: A treaty signed at the papal seat.
explanation.walkthrough: A concordat is a treaty between the Pope and a state.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the formal treaty between the Holy See and a secular government.

clue.text: It's only just on target

parts.note: a shot in the ... ring of an archery target barely counts as a hit

explanation.surface: Something that barely hits the mark.
explanation.definitionFit: In archery or shooting, the ring furthest from the bull scores lowest.

clue.text: The great brute is short of money

explanation.surface: The huge beast is low on cash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Is short' says the word is the shortened form of the animal's full name.
explanation.definitionFit: The abbreviated name of the horned beast, and old British slang for cash.

clue.text: Reformed brute may prove the contrary

indicators.note: the word brute is re-formed into a new arrangement of its letters

explanation.surface: A reformed thug might show himself to be different.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebut an argument is to refute it with evidence.

clue.text: Patient man's task ? It's the other way round

definitions.text: Patient man's task ? It's the other way round

parts.words: Patient man's task ? It's the other way round
parts.note: the patient man is the biblical Job, so his task is the work of Job; swap the two nouns round

explanation.surface: Work for a patient person, but reversed.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece of work is a task, here phrased with the patriarch's name.

clue.text: Vessel gets, a shock

explanation.surface: A ship receives a jolt.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot or container, and a jolt or unpleasant jarring.

clue.text: Clip joint operator strips to the skin

definitions.text: Clip joint operator strips to the skin

parts.words: Clip joint operator strips to the skin
parts.note: a 'clip joint' is a rip-off club, but here it is a sheep station where wool is clipped, and the worker takes the fleece off down to the skin

explanation.surface: A sleazy nightclub owner fleeces customers right down to nothing.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who clips sheep removes their wool.

clue.text: Beg' rent in order to eat

indicators.note: the letters are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Plead for the rent money so you can afford food.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' shuffles RENT and EAT together.
explanation.definitionFit: To entreat is to implore or plead.
